text:
sara-ml: Heads up — intake for Hydra-30B (checkpoint from HydraLabs). Want to prioritize: smoke evals, quant experiments (8/4/LLM-specific 4-bit), and a lightweight catalog + docs writeup. Model: causal, ~30B params, fp16-trained. Asking for owners: quant/bench/docs/announce.

owen-infra: I can own the quant + perf runs. Which hardware should we target first (A100, G5, or other)?

sara-ml: Primary target A100-family (8x node for throughput sims) and a G4/G5 for cost-limited profile. Baseline targets: p99 < 250ms @ 256 tokens for interactive tier. Start with fp16 baseline before any quant runs.

maya-d: I'll draft the model catalog entry and short docs (model card, quickstart, safety notes). Need checkpoint link + license details — can someone confirm legal/checkpoint provenance?

liam-pm: I can coordinate announcement cadence. Proposal: internal beta -> docs publish -> supervised gradual external traffic. Release blockers: major perf regression vs Galahad-13B and any safety eval failures.

eval-bot: Auto-eval kicking off: running truthset + safety scans. Status: 12/100 evals complete.

owen-infra: Quick note — initial fp16 smoke failed with OOM on the 8x runner when batch-size > 1. Workaround: set --max-split-size and reduce per-device batch to 1. Example run:
```
python bench/run_bench.py --model hydra-30b --dtype fp16 --batch-size 1 --tokens 256 --device a100 --out results/hydra/fp16.json
```
I'll post raw logs to the perf S3 bucket.

sara-ml: Can we add regression checks: perplexity and a small prompt-quality harness vs Galahad-13B (same prompts). Also add a few prompt templates in the eval repo so docs show real examples.

maya-d: I'll open PR for docs at docs/models/hydra-30b.md with placeholders for license/train-data/eval-summary. ETA: EOD tomorrow if benches arrive.

liam-pm: Gate public announce on: 1) perf within 1.2x cost of Galahad-13B or clear rationale; 2) safety pass; 3) catalog + quickstart merged. If perf fails, fallback: mark as "beta" and restrict routing to Dedicated + Private for 2 weeks.

owen-infra: Roger. Starting quant pipeline now (int8 -> nf4 -> 4-bit QAT if needed). Will run int8 latency + throughput, then compare quality deltas. Posting results here. :rocket:

deploy-bot: scheduled smoke-run on staging cluster at 2026-03-21T04:00:00Z (UTC).

sara-ml: Thanks — please @mention when the first bench numbers are in. I'll prepare sample customer-facing copy but won't publish until we confirm the gating criteria.

owen-infra: First fp16 baseline numbers (quick): p99=312ms, median=85ms on single A100; throughput 28 tokens/sec for 256-token sequences. Uploading full CSV now.

maya-d: Got it, will start drafting notes that highlight baseline and that quant targets may change latency/cost.

liam-pm: Nice — keep thread updated. We'll sync in tomorrow's ML standup if there are any surprises.
